sites.name: ayurvedichealingvillage.com (KTAHV)
sites.blocker: AHV ENGLISH STAGING CANDIDATE (PR #309, MERGEABLE but BLOCKED and still DRAFT). 2026-09-16 evening: programme-section navigation rebuilt per D-20260916-10 (one finder template on 5 routes with the shared trust block, 5 training courses in the finders and linked from the hub, hub on /ayurveda-training-programme/ with -programs canonicalised, persistent shortlist, mobile-first flash fixed); 252-route sweep 0 errors; course detail pages on the package template still open; design audit 28/66 templates, resume queued. docs/reports/2026-09-16-ahv-programme-navigation-delivery.md. Earlier: 252 approved English routes live on a protected Vercel preview. This session fixed 8 owner-reported and audit-found defects -- homepage touch-scroll (touch-action:none blocked scrolling over every homepage photo), a visible spam honeypot on the enquiry form, 85 Cloudflare [email-protected] placeholders decoded to the locked public address, a dead locale control (now EN current + DE/FR 'coming soon'), a cookie notice that existed on 2 of 136 templates (now site-wide), and the enquiry form sitting 6,028px down its own page (now 391px). Full UI/UX sweep of all 68 design families at both widths: ZERO hard defects (no overflow, no JS errors, no 4xx, no broken images, no missing alt). Measurement ids recorded in analytics.config.json and deliberately INERT on staging (AHV_ANALYTICS unset) so reviewers never reach production GA4/Clarity. SERVER-SIDE RENDERING CLOSED 2026-09-16 (commits 81e586d3 + 4e88a2a6): the approved design's own compiled output is now captured at build time and delivered in the server response, so a non-JS crawler reads min 1,438 / median 6,259 / max 30,020 chars across all 252 routes (0 below 600, 0 without h1; homepage 296 -> 18,322). With JavaScript fully disabled the homepage paints the full design and 70/70 images. The design is NOT rebuilt or re-themed -- the runtime still mounts on hydration and replaces the snapshot. Re-verified 504 browser states (252 routes x 390px and 1280px): 0 render failures, 0 missing h1, 0 overflow, 0 broken images, 0 JS errors. Serving the markup exposed 16 internal links that 404 (pre-existing legacy spellings that boot.ts had only ever corrected in the browser, too late for a crawler); 13 repaired via english-candidate/link-aliases.json plus 20 Cloudflare email links normalised to the locked public address. Homepage response is now 527KB raw / ~85KB gzip -- 57% is the design's own inline styles, deliberately kept because they are what makes the server HTML paint correctly before JS. Sitemap/robots verified under AHV_STAGING=0: 252 loc entries, canonical host, zero /lp/ pages. Report: docs/reports/2026-09-16-ahv-ssr-delivery.md. TECHNICAL LINK AUDIT CLOSED 2026-09-16 (commit 4c33a19d): owner ruled (D-20260916-06) that inherited claim/clinical-language issues are NOT go-live blockers because the English build is a port of already-published content, and that the bar is zero 404s and zero wrong linking. Audited 1,849 internal URLs plus a full link-graph crawl. Biggest find: 228 links kept the PRODUCTION origin in the server HTML (226 on /sitemap alone) -- boot.ts fixed them at runtime so no visitor saw it, but a crawler followed them off the deployment, and a non-JS crawl reached only 180 of 252 pages. Localised, plus a malformed tel: URL, a missing /ahv asset prefix, a link whose anchor text (not its slug) identified the right target, two legacy WordPress media paths, three DE/RU links, and 10 http->https upgrades on verified hosts. Deployed staging now crawls 233 pages with 0 broken and 0 insecure links. ONE 404 REMAINS and cannot be fixed here: /download/ayurvedaworkshop-in-kairali.pdf is 404 on LIVE PRODUCTION too -- the file does not exist anywhere and needs Deepu. GO-LIVE TIME BOMB RECORDED: 49 distinct og:image URLs across 182 of 252 pages all point at /wp-content/ on the production domain; 46 resolve today but ALL break the moment DNS points at Vercel. Report: docs/reports/2026-09-16-ahv-technical-link-audit.md. BLOCKERS TO GO-LIVE: (1) owner decisions on the og:image /wp-content exposure and on 27 orphan routes (a cart, checkout and my-account page on a hospital site, four test pages, six superseded -old duplicates, and a French page in the English build) -- /de/behandlung-in-kerala.html (also on the Ads cutover map, Vikash's call), /de/lakshya-yoga-retreat-2017 and /treatment-in-kerala-russian.html; guessing a target would invent a fact; (2) Deepu must sign off the enquiry/contact forms, which fail closed today; (3) KTAHV clinical language lock -- 191 of 252 routes, 2,772 occurrences, a GST-exposure decision for the owner and Dr. Deepu John; (4) PR #309's five required checks cannot START due to the GitHub Actions billing limit. Google Ads CORRECTED 2026-09-15: the earlier 'no conversion action' note was read from the MANAGER account and was wrong. Active client AHV-NEO 712-961-0573 runs 66 campaigns, Rs 650,776/30d, with 27 conversion actions; EnquirySubmission (ctId 15644955) fires AW-972059125/fqrBCJvyugcQ9ePBzwM from the live /ppc-thanks/ page and is NOT ported to the new stack - a tested, unactivated candidate exists. Go-live steps: docs/reports/2026-09-15-ahv-go-live-checklist.md
